0022600106.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (0-2, 14th in the East, 5th in the Central) are on a two-game losing streak heading into this road game, while the Philadelphia 76ers (2-0) sit first in the East and first in the Atlantic. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and Milwaukee lost all four matchups with Philadelphia in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
